notes.title: NEW DIGITAL RELEASE: Goblin Vaults
notes.notes:
Goblin Vaults: A Roll Player Tale is a strategy card game for 1-5 players featuring bidding, card placement and scoring patterns. In the game, you wager cards to win loot from the central cell block, then stash that loot wisely in your vault.

1-5 Players  |  30 Minutes  |  Ages 14+

Invite your family & friends to play Goblin Vaults or checkout the SOLO mode! Now available on the Sovranti app & FREE to play all December 2023!

notes.title: NEW DIGITAL RELEASE: Mission Catastrophe
notes.notes:
In Mission Catastrophe, you are scrambling to keep the ship functional as a group long enough to get yourself into a working Escape Pod. The game ends when you escape or when the Ship Integrity is fully compromised and explodes, sending everyone into space!

1-6 Players  |  30-60 Minutes  |  Ages 10+

Invite your family & friends to play Mission Catastrophe or checkout the SOLO mode! Now available on the Sovranti app!

notes.title: NEW DIGITAL RELEASE: Dollars to Donuts
notes.notes:
In Dollars to Donuts, you take turns purchasing tiles and placing them onto your player mats to create delicious spreads of donuts! Match identical halves to create perfect donuts that can be served to customers. Mismatched donuts can be sold off for cash to spend on other tiles or place them as donuts onto the board!

Invite your family & friends to play Dollars to Donuts or checkout the SOLO mode! Now available on the Sovranti app!

notes.title: NEW DIGITAL RELEASE: 20 Strong Solar Sentinels
notes.notes:
20 Strong Solar Sentinels is a SOLO card game of strategy, probability, and resource management.

Play 20 Strong Solar Sentinels on Sovranti. Now available on the Sovranti app!

notes.title: NEW DIGITAL RELEASE: Lockup: A Roll Player Tale
notes.notes:
Lockup is a competitive worker-placement game for 1-5 players.  In this game, players manage groups of minions locked up in Kulbak Prison.  Gain the most reputation for your chance at freedom and glory!

Invite your family & friends to play Lockup on Sovranti. Now available on the Sovranti app!

notes.title: NEW DIGITAL RELEASE: Castles by the Sea
notes.notes:
Castles by the Sea is a magical sandcastle-building game. As a kingdom of Shorelings, your goal is to build and populate sandcastles.

Invite your family & friends to play Castles by the Sea on the Sovranti app.

notes.title: NEW DIGITAL RELEASE: Four Humours
notes.notes:
You are a medieval doctor visiting citizens of the kingdom and you're competing to claim your medical fame. Your "personality potions", inspired by the Four Humours, are used to sway citizens in your favor. The Principles of Personality are the governing rules to resolve personality conflicts that exist between citizens.

Invite your family & friends to play Four Humours on the Sovranti app.

notes.title: NEW DIGITAL RELEASE: Forges of Ravenshire
notes.notes:
Grab your hammer and some steel, it's time to forge. The Blacksmiths Guild of Ravenshire is in need of a new Forgemaster. You and your fellow smiths are competing to see who can make the most money and become the new Forgemaster.

Invite your family & friends to play Forges of Ravenshire on the Sovranti app. Available to play now!
